criteria.quote: "Arbok's warning face may hide over twenty versions."
criteria.revision: Replace the opening narration with: "Arbok's belly patterns were once confirmed at six. Latest research says there may be over 20 arrangements." This foregrounds the concrete contradiction instead of only announcing the final number.

criteria.quote: "Reports said its belly markings differed from area to area."
"Why were six patterns confirmed when Arbok may have over 20 arrangements?"
criteria.revision: Replace the open loop with: "How did Arbok's pattern record go from regional rumors, to six confirmed variations, to over 20 possible arrangements?" The supplied research supports that chronology, but does not explain why the count changed.

criteria.quote: "Arbok's warning face may hide over twenty versions." ... "Latest research found over twenty possible arrangements on Arbok's stomach."
criteria.revision: Do not fully reveal the over-20 result in Scene 1. Make Scene 1 ask the six-to-over-20 question, then progress through regional variation, six confirmed patterns, the pattern's intimidation role, and finally reveal the latest over-20 finding.

criteria.quote: "SIX BECOMES A SWARM OF MORE THAN TWENTY."
criteria.revision: Hold back "over twenty" until the final factual reveal. The jump from six confirmed variations to over 20 possible arrangements is the draft's strongest surprise, but it is currently spoiled by the title, opening headline, and first narration line.

Make the first scene about the unresolved count change rather than repeating the final finding. For example, change its headline to "SIX... OR OVER TWENTY?" and narration to "Arbok's belly-pattern count changed dramatically."

criteria.quote: "Arbok’s belly is not one fixed warning face: research moved from six confirmed variants to over 20 possible arrangements."
criteria.revision: Make the payoff resolve the record's progression: "First came reports that Arbok's belly markings differed by area. Then six variations were confirmed. Latest research raised the possibility to over 20 arrangements." This is stronger than simply repeating the six-to-20 claim.

criteria.quote: "One frightening face or twenty possible ones: which works better?"
criteria.revision: Replace it with: "Which is the bigger Arbok surprise: that six pattern variations were confirmed, or that latest research found over 20 possible arrangements?" This creates a credible preference split without claiming either pattern count works better.
